skill.name: screenshots
skill.description: Create high-resolution marketing screenshots from a running web app with Playwright. Use it for Product Hunt, social posts, landing pages, and documentation.
skill.summary: Guides browser-based capture of high-resolution web app screenshots for launches and documentation.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static shell, network, and upload findings are Markdown examples or local Playwright workflow steps, not hidden exfiltration. The material risks are generated script execution, plaintext credential handling, and local persistence of authenticated screenshots. Publication should require warnings and safer credential guidance.

remediation.issue: Plaintext credential collection and script embedding
remediation.suggestion: Use demo accounts, avoid storing passwords in generated files, and prefer secure prompts or pre-authenticated browser state.
Show the generated Playwright script and ask for explicit user confirmation before running node screenshot-script.mjs.
Require users to review PNG files for secrets, customer data, and tokens before sharing or publishing them.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams need consistent app screenshots for launches and documentation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Playwright capture workflows.
actual_capabilities: Finds likely screenshot routes by reading app documentation and router files.
Asks for screenshot count, purpose, authentication needs, and feature selection.
Generates a Playwright script with 1440x900 viewport and 2x device scale.
Captures full-page, element-focused, modal, animation, and dark-mode examples.
Saves PNG files under a screenshots directory and summarizes resolution details.
limitations: Requires a running web app URL and Playwright support in the project.
Login automation may fail on uncommon forms or multi-factor authentication.
Screenshots can expose sensitive app data unless users prepare safe demo content.
The skill does not edit screenshots after capture or publish them automatically.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Assets
use_cases.description: Create a focused set of polished app screenshots for Product Hunt, social posts, or landing pages.

use_cases.title: Refresh Documentation Images
use_cases.description: Capture consistent UI reference images after a product release or interface redesign.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Presentation
use_cases.description: Generate retina screenshots across core routes to inspect layout, states, and visual quality.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Public Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three marketing screenshots for my app at http://localhost:3000. Use public pages only.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Launch Screenshots
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the strongest five Product Hunt screenshots for this app. Review the README and routes, then ask me to confirm the list.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Protected Documentation Screens
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate documentation screenshots for the dashboard after login. Ask for credentials securely, use demo data, and avoid private customer records.

prompt_templates.title: Build Advanced Screenshot Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Playwright screenshot plan for light and dark mode, modal states, and full-page captures. Verify image dimensions and summarize each file.

output_examples.input: Capture five launch screenshots for a Vite app on localhost.
output_examples.output: Created five retina PNG screenshots in screenshots, covering dashboard, editor, analytics, settings, and onboarding.

output_examples.input: Take documentation screenshots after I log in with demo credentials.
output_examples.output: Generated authenticated UI captures, confirmed 2880x1800 dimensions, and noted which screens may need manual review.
Saved matching light and dark mode captures with consistent viewport size and numbered filenames.

best_practices: Use demo accounts and seeded data before capturing authenticated screens.
Confirm the screenshot list with the user before generating the script.
Review each PNG for private data before sharing it outside the workspace.
anti_patterns: Do not use production credentials or private customer data for marketing screenshots.
Do not run generated browser scripts without showing the plan to the user.
Do not assume default localhost ports match every project.

faq.question: Does this skill upload screenshots?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow saves PNG files locally under a screenshots directory.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What framework does it require?
faq.answer: It requires Playwright and a reachable web app URL.

faq.question: Can it capture protected pages?
faq.answer: Yes, but use demo accounts and avoid production secrets or private data.

faq.question: What resolution does it target?
faq.answer: It targets a 1440x900 viewport with 2x device scale, producing 2880x1800 images.

faq.question: Can it choose pages automatically?
faq.answer: It can inspect documentation and routes, then asks the user to confirm screenshots.
